<DESCRIPTION>DELTA INVENTORY SUPPLY AGREEMENT
<TEXT>
<HTML><HEAD>
<TITLE>Delta Inventory Supply Agreement</TITLE>
</HEAD>
 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="right"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>EXHIBIT 10(vi) </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>DELTA INVENTORY SUPPLY AGREEMENT </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>THIS DELTA INVENTORY SUPPLY AGREEMENT</B> (this
&#147;<U>Agreement</U>&#148;) is made as of this 1st day of December, 2006 (the &#147;<U>Effective Date</U>&#148;), by and between United Launch Alliance, L.L.C., a Delaware limited liability company (&#147;<U>ULA</U>&#148;) and The Boeing Company,
a Delaware corporation (&#147;<U>Boeing</U>&#148;). ULA and Boeing are sometimes referred to herein as a &#147;<U>Party</U>&#148; or collectively as the &#147;<U>Parties</U>.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px"
ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><U>RECITALS </U></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>WHEREAS</B>, Boeing, Lockheed Martin Corporation, a
Maryland corporation (&#147;<U>Lockheed Martin</U>&#148;), and ULA entered into a Joint Venture Master Agreement dated as of May&nbsp;2, 2005 (as amended, the &#147;<U>Master Agreement</U>&#148;), which provides, among other things, for the
formation of a joint venture, ULA, to develop and manufacture integrated ELV Systems and supply related Launch Services to the U.S. Government upon the terms and subject to the conditions of the Master Agreement; </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>WHEREAS</B>, ULA has, as part of its charter, authority to manufacture and sell Launch Services to the U.S. Government using the Delta II and Delta IV
launch vehicles developed by Boeing; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>WHEREAS</B>, in connection with the Closing of the transactions contemplated by the Master
Agreement, Boeing has licensed certain Delta technology to ULA and has contributed or caused to be contributed certain assets of its ELV Business to ULA (other than the Excluded Inventory, as defined below); and </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>WHEREAS</B>, the Master Agreement requires that Boeing and ULA enter into this Agreement; </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>NOW THEREFORE</B>, in consideration of the mutual promises and undertakings contained herein, and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt
and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties, intending to be legally bound, hereby agree as follows: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><U>AGREEMENT
</U></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>ARTICLE 1 <U>DEFINITIONS; EXCLUDED INVENTORY</U> </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">1.1 <U>General</U>. As used herein, terms that are capitalized have the definitions ascribed to them by the Master Agreement, except as those definitions may be varied by the terms of this Agreement. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">1.2 &#147;<U>Tooling</U>&#148; means jigs, dies, fixtures, molds, patterns, taps, gauges, other equipment and manufacturing aids, all components of these
items, and replacements of these items, which are of such a specialized nature that without substantial modification or alteration their use is limited to the development or production of particular supplies or parts thereof or to the performance of
particular services. </FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">1.3 <U>Excluded Inventory</U>. On the Closing Date, pursuant to the terms and conditions of the Boeing
Contribution and Assumption Agreement, Boeing contributed or caused to be contributed to ULA the Boeing Contributed Assets. These assets included some items of inventory but excluded the &#147;Excluded Inventory,&#148; as defined in the Master
Agreement. The Parties acknowledge and agree that the Excluded Inventory subject to this Agreement shall be determined in accordance with the following principles and procedures: </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">1.3.1 Excluded Inventory shall not include any Tooling. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">1.3.2 Promptly following the Closing Date, Boeing shall prepare and submit to ULA and Lockheed Martin a statement setting forth
Boeing&#146;s Proposed Adjusted Net Working Capital Amount in accordance with Section&nbsp;3.04 of the Master Agreement. The amount of inventory included in Boeing&#146;s Proposed Adjusted Net Working Capital Amount and in Boeing&#146;s Adjusted Net
Working Capital Amount (which may be a positive or negative number) will equal the aggregate value of the inventory of Boeing&#146;s ELV Business (including the Excluded Inventory), minus $1,860,000,000. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">1.3.3 The value of the inventory of Boeing&#146;s ELV Business shall be determined in accordance with the accounting principles, policies,
practices, methods and procedures, applied on a consistent basis in accordance with past practice, utilized in the preparation of Boeing&#146;s Opening Statement as disclosed in the Notes to such Opening Statement, except as otherwise set forth in
the Notes to such Opening Statement. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">1.3.4 The agreed-upon value of the Excluded Inventory subject to this Agreement shall
be $1,860,000,000. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>ARTICLE 2 <U>OWNERSHIP OF EXCLUDED INVENTORY</U> </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">2.1 <U>Transfer and Assignment</U>. Boeing hereby transfers and assigns to ULA all of its right, title and interest in and to the Excluded Inventory, including its rights under any warranties from suppliers of items
of Excluded Inventory to the extent that such rights are assignable; <U>provided</U> that Boeing shall use reasonable commercial efforts to take all actions and execute all documents reasonably necessary to assign its rights under any such
warranties. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">2.2 <U>Acceptance</U>. ULA hereby accepts (i)&nbsp;all of Boeing&#146;s right, title and interest in and to the Excluded
Inventory and (ii)&nbsp;subject to the provisions of Section&nbsp;5.1, all risk of loss with respect to the Excluded Inventory. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>ARTICLE 3
<U>REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES</U> </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">3.1 <U>Title; Condition</U>. Boeing represents and warrants that (i)&nbsp;it had, immediately
prior to the transfer and assignment to ULA pursuant to Article&nbsp;2, good title to items in the Excluded Inventory and (ii)&nbsp;the items of Excluded Inventory, to the extent consisting of tangible property, are in good operating condition
(normal wear and tear excepted), and normal maintenance and repair on such items has not been deferred. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">2 </FONT></P>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">3.2 <U>DISCLAIMER OF WARRANTIES</U>. THE PARTIES HERETO ACKNOWLEDGE AND AGREE THAT NO REPRESENTATION OR
WARRANTY HAS BEEN MADE OR RELIED UPON BY ANY PARTY HERETO OTHER THAN THOSE EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT OR THE MASTER AGREEMENT. WITHOUT LIMITING THE GENERALITY OF THE DISCLAIMER SET FORTH IN THE PRECEDING SENTENCE, EACH PARTY, ON ITS OWN
BEHALF AND ON BEHALF OF ITS RESPECTIVE SUBSIDIARIES, EXPRESSLY DISCLAIMS ANY IMPLIED WARRANTIES, INCLUDING WARRANTIES OF FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">3.3 <U>Survival</U>. The representations and warranties of Boeing set forth in Section&nbsp;3.1 shall survive the Closing for a period of two years from
the Closing Date. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>ARTICLE 4 <U>PURCHASE OF EXCLUDED INVENTORY</U> </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">4.1 <U>Price and Payment Schedule</U>. Within 30 days after each launch or other event that consumes one or more Delta IV common booster cores, commencing on the earlier of (x)&nbsp;the consumption of the eighth such
common booster core consumed on or after January&nbsp;1, 2007 or (y)&nbsp;March&nbsp;31, 2009, ULA will pay Boeing $60,000,000 for each such common booster core, <U>provided</U> that in no event will payments be made under this Agreement in respect
of more than 31 such common booster cores. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">4.2 <U>Taxes</U>. ULA will bear any personal property or other taxes relating to the Excluded
Inventory. The Parties acknowledge that the purchase price does not include any value added tax, sales tax or similar tax. ULA agrees to either pay such taxes or reimburse Boeing for any such taxes that Boeing must pay as a result of the sale of the
items of Excluded Inventory to ULA. Boeing shall cooperate with ULA and provide documentation reasonably necessary to lessen taxes for which ULA is responsible under this provision or to support a claim of tax exemption, where applicable.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">4.3 <U>Payment</U>. ULA will make all payments to Boeing by unconditional wire transfer of immediately available funds in United States
Dollars to a bank account in the United States designated by Boeing. Boeing shall not be required to invoice ULA as a condition precedent for ULA&#146;s obligation to make payments. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">4.4 <U>Payment On March&nbsp;31, 2021</U>. On March&nbsp;31, 2021, ULA will pay to Boeing an amount equal to the product of (x)&nbsp;$60,000,000 and
(y)&nbsp;the amount, if any, by which 31 exceeds the number of Delta&nbsp;IV common booster cores in respect of which ULA has made payments to Boeing pursuant to this Agreement prior thereto. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">4.5 <U>Payment Upon Full Recovery of Excluded Inventory</U>. If, at any time prior to March&nbsp;31, 2021, all inventory constituting Boeing Contributed
Assets and Excluded Inventory has been recovered and payment in full has been received by ULA as a result of any event other </FONT>
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">3 </FONT></P>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">
<FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">than normal consumption through the provision of Launch Services, including but not limited to Delta Program termination, sale of the Delta launch vehicle
business or reimbursement by Boeing to ULA under the provisions of Section&nbsp;6 of Schedule 11.02(b) to the Master Agreement, the payment specified in Section&nbsp;4.4 of this Agreement shall become immediately due and payable by ULA to Boeing.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">4.6 <U>Payment From ULA Credit Arrangements</U>. Notwithstanding the foregoing provisions of this Article 4, but without limiting
ULA&#146;s obligation to make any payment otherwise required pursuant to the terms and provisions of this Agreement as and when such payment is due, it is understood and agreed that for a period of five years from the date of this Agreement, without
the prior written agreement of Lockheed Martin and Boeing, ULA will not make payments pursuant to Section&nbsp;4.1 of this Agreement with the proceeds of borrowings under the Member Revolving Credit Agreement, the Initial Company Financing
Arrangement or any other revolving credit agreement or similar financing arrangement that replaces or supplements the Member Revolving Credit Agreement, the Initial Company Financing Arrangement or any subsequent replacement or supplemental
agreement to support ULA&#146;s working capital and other financing needs (any of the foregoing, a &#147;<U>ULA Financing Arrangement</U>&#148;), except as follows: </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(i) ULA may use the proceeds of borrowings under one or more ULA Financing Arrangements in an aggregate amount of $300,000,000 to make
payments pursuant to Section&nbsp;4.1 of this Agreement without limitation; and </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(ii) from and after the time that aggregate
payments of $300,000,000 pursuant to Section&nbsp;4.1 of this Agreement have been made with the proceeds of borrowings under one or more ULA Financing Arrangements as provided in the preceding clause (i), ULA may use the proceeds of borrowings under
one or more ULA Financing Arrangements to make payments pursuant to Section&nbsp;4.1 of this Agreement, but only to the extent that the aggregate amount of borrowings outstanding under the ULA Financing Arrangements, after all or a portion of any
payment then due pursuant to Section&nbsp;4.1 of this Agreement is made, do not exceed $300,000,000. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">It is the intention of the parties hereto that from
and after the expiration of the five-year period covered by the foregoing provisions of this Section&nbsp;4.6, ULA will adopt, subject to approval of the Members, a financing plan that ensures that working capital is available to fund operations
above and beyond amounts available for payments pursuant to Section&nbsp;4.1 of this Agreement; provided, however, that, following such five-year period, until such a financing plan is agreed to and implemented by the Company and the Members, ULA
may use the proceeds of borrowings under one or more ULA Financing Arrangements to make payments pursuant to Section&nbsp;4.1 of this Agreement, but only to the extent that the aggregate amount of borrowings outstanding under the ULA Financing
Arrangements, after all or a portion of any payment then due pursuant to Section&nbsp;4.1 of this Agreement is made, do not exceed 80% of the aggregate credit capacity represented by all of the then existing ULA Financing Arrangements. It is
understood and agreed that the foregoing provisions of this Section&nbsp;4.6 shall not detract from Boeing&#146;s right to receive payments from ULA as and when due pursuant to Section&nbsp;4.1 of this Agreement, which right shall rank <U>pari</U>
<U>passu</U> with the rights of other parties (including Lockheed Martin) to receive payments due from ULA. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">4 </FONT></P>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>ARTICLE 5 <U>OTHER TERMS AND CONDITIONS.</U> </B></FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">5.1 <U>Indemnification</U>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman"
SIZE="2">5.1.1 ULA hereby indemnifies Boeing, its Affiliates and its Representatives (together with their respective successors and permitted assigns) against, and agrees to defend and hold them harmless from, any and all Damages incurred or
suffered by any of them arising out of, resulting from or related to any Third Party Claim with respect to any defect in an Excluded Inventory item, including claims arising from a launch failure. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">5.1.2 In addition to and without limiting the other provisions of this Section&nbsp;5.1, each Party hereby indemnifies the other Party,
and each of its Affiliates and their Representatives (together with their respective successors and permitted assigns) against, and agrees to defend and hold them harmless from, any and all Damages incurred or suffered by any of them arising out of,
resulting from or related to any breach by such indemnifying Party of any representation, warranty, covenant or agreement made or to be performed by such indemnifying Party pursuant to this Agreement; <U>provided</U> that Boeing&#146;s obligation to
indemnify ULA for any breach of the representations and warranties set forth in Section&nbsp;3.1 shall be subject to (i)&nbsp;the provisions of Section&nbsp;5.16 and (ii)&nbsp;the limitations set forth in Section&nbsp;11.04 of the Master Agreement
as if such indemnification was provided thereunder for a breach of a representation or warranty set forth in the Master Agreement. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">5.2
<U>Term and Termination</U>. This Agreement will be effective as of the Closing Date and shall continue until the earliest of (i)&nbsp;the final payment by ULA to Boeing pursuant to Section&nbsp;4.1 in respect of the launch or other event occurring
that consumes the last of the Delta IV common booster cores constituting Excluded Inventory, (ii)&nbsp;March 31, 2021, (iii)&nbsp;the payment by ULA to Boeing pursuant to Section&nbsp;4.5 of the amount specified in Section&nbsp;4.4, or (iv)&nbsp;the
mutual written agreement of the Parties to terminate this Agreement; <U>provided</U> that the termination of this Agreement shall not relieve the Parties of any obligations existing hereunder at the time termination is effective under this
Section&nbsp;5.2. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">5.3 <U>Notices</U>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">5.3.1 <U>Authorized Representatives</U>. Each Party shall appoint an authorized representative (an &#147;<U>Authorized Representative</U>&#148;) for purposes of delivery and receipt of all notices, requests and other
communications hereunder. Boeing&#146;s initial Authorized Representative shall be the Chief Financial Officer of Boeing Integrated Defense Systems. Boeing may designate a new person as Boeing&#146;s Authorized Representative at any time by delivery
of written notice to ULA. ULA&#146;s initial Authorized Representative shall be the Chief Financial Officer of ULA. ULA may </FONT>
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">5 </FONT></P>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%">
<FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">designate a new person as ULA&#146;s Authorized Representative at any time by delivery of written notice to Boeing. All notices, requests and other
communications delivered hereunder shall be in writing (including telecopy or similar writing) and shall be delivered to the Party&#146;s Authorized Representative. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">5.3.2 <U>Disputes</U>. Notwithstanding the provisions of Section&nbsp;5.3.1, all notices, requests and other communications with respect
to disputes arising hereunder shall be in writing (including telecopy or similar writing) and shall be given as follows: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman"

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="right"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><U>Annex A </U></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><U>Dispute Resolution Procedures </U></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a) In the event of any controversy or claim between the Parties
arising out of, relating to or in connection with any provision of this Agreement, or the rights or obligations of the Parties hereunder, the Parties shall try to settle their differences amicably between themselves. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(b) Either Party may initiate such informal dispute resolution by sending written notice of the dispute to the other Party, and within 10 days after such
notice, senior management level representatives of the Parties, or other representatives of the Parties who have been delegated authority to resolve the dispute, shall meet, in person or by telephone, for attempted resolution by good faith
negotiations. If such representatives do not resolve such dispute within 45 days of receipt of the dispute notice for any reason, the Parties agree to seek the assistance of the members of the Board of Directors of ULA in resolving the dispute;
<U>provided</U> that the Parties shall not be bound by any decision of the Board of Directors. If the Parties have not resolved the dispute within 30 days after seeking the assistance of the Board of Directors of ULA, then the Parties agree to
submit the dispute to final and binding arbitration before a panel of three arbitrators in New York, New York under the Commercial Arbitration Rules of the American Arbitration Association (the &#147;AAA Rules&#148;). </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(c) Arbitration will be commenced by a Party filing a demand for arbitration pursuant to the AAA Rules (an &#147;Arbitration Demand&#148;). That Party
also shall send a copy of the Arbitration Demand to the other Party. Each Party to the dispute shall select an arbitrator within 10 days of the date of the Arbitration Demand and shall so notify the other Party in writing, or, if a Party to the
dispute fails to select an arbitrator within such 10 day period, the American Arbitration Association (the &#147;AAA&#148;) shall make such appointment within five days thereafter and shall notify the Parties in writing. Within 10 days from their
appointment, the two arbitrators thus appointed shall select a third arbitrator, who shall act as the chairman of the panel, and shall notify the Parties in writing of his or her selection. If the two arbitrators fail to agree on a third arbitrator
within 10 days of their selection, the AAA shall make the appointment within five days thereafter and shall notify the Parties in writing. If an arbitrator so selected becomes unable to serve, his or her successors shall be similarly selected or
appointed. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(d) The arbitration shall be conducted pursuant to the Federal Arbitration Act and such procedures as the Parties may agree,
or, in the absence of such agreement, pursuant to the AAA Rules. The arbitrators will agree to comply with the Federal Arbitration Act and the procedures agreed to by the Parties, or if applicable, the AAA Rules (including any and all of the time
deadlines governing the arbitrators&#146; conduct set forth in the Federal Arbitration Act, the procedures agreed to by the Parties and the AAA Rules, as applicable) and the terms of this Annex A. The arbitrators shall have case management authority
and shall resolve the dispute in final within 180 days from the commencement of the arbitration. In the event the arbitrators fail to resolve the dispute in final within 180 days from the commencement of the arbitration, either Party may serve a
written notice to the arbitrators and to the other Party that requires the arbitrators to resolve the dispute in final within 30 days of service of such written notice, <U>provided</U> that if the Party not serving the written notice asserts that
the failure to resolve the dispute within such 180-day period was due to delay by the Party serving the written notice, such </FONT>
</P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">
<FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">30-day period shall be extended by the number of days, if any, that the arbitrators (by written decision issued within such 30-day period) determine the
Party serving the written notice was dilatory. If the arbitrators fail to resolve the dispute within such 30 (or extended) - day period, either Party may remove the case from arbitration and file the action as a lawsuit in accordance with
Section&nbsp;5.14 of this Agreement. In the event a Party removes the case from arbitration pursuant to the provisions hereof, each Party hereby waives any objection that it may now or hereafter have to such removal or that such dispute continues to
be subject to arbitration. For purposes of calculating the effects of any statutes of limitations, any lawsuit initiated pursuant to this provision will be deemed to have been filed on the date that the arbitration was commenced, as established by
the Federal Arbitration Act or the AAA Rules, if applicable. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(e) The Parties agree that each shall have the right to conduct discovery and
present evidence in accordance with the following rules. Each Party shall be allowed to conduct reasonable discovery through written document requests and depositions, the nature and extent of which discovery shall be determined by the Parties;
<U>provided</U>, that if the Parties cannot agree on the terms of discovery, the nature and extent thereof will be determined by the arbitrators who will take into account the needs of the Parties and the purposes of arbitration to make discovery
expeditious and cost effective. Access to any confidential or proprietary financial or other information produced in discovery will be limited to the discovering Party&#146;s lawyers and other experts and a limited number (to be agreed by the
Parties) of senior managers of the discovering Party, who will be obligated to preserve the confidentiality of such information on reasonable and customary terms. Each Party shall provide to the other, reasonably in advance of the hearing, copies of
all documents which a Party intends to present at the hearing. Each Party shall be entitled to make an oral presentation to the arbitrators. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman"
SIZE="2">(f) The Parties agree that a judgment may be entered on the arbitrators&#146; award in any court of competent jurisdiction. The arbitrators in reviewing any claim under this Agreement shall have the exclusive authority to determine any
issues as to the arbitrability of any such claim or related disputes hereunder. In reaching a decision, the arbitrators shall interpret, apply and be bound by this Agreement and by Applicable Law. The arbitrators shall have no authority to add to,
detract from or modify this Agreement or any Applicable Law in any respect. The arbitrators may grant any remedy or relief that a court of competent jurisdiction could grant, except that the arbitrators may not grant any relief or remedy greater
than that sought by the Parties, nor any special, indirect, punitive or consequential damages, including lost profits and opportunity costs (except in each case to the extent assessed in connection with claims by other Persons). </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(g) Any up-front costs of the arbitrators shall be borne equally by the Parties engaged in such dispute; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, that the
non-prevailing Party in any such arbitration shall pay, and to the extent applicable reimburse the prevailing Party for, the costs and expenses of the arbitrators, including costs and expenses payable to the AAA and to the arbitrators; and
<U>provided</U> <U>further</U>, that in the event each Party prevails as to certain claims in connection with any such arbitration, the fees of the arbitrators shall be paid and/or reimbursed in accordance with the decision of the arbitrators. Each
Party shall bear its own costs incurred in connection with attorneys&#146; fees and related expenses. </FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(h) Notwithstanding the provisions of this Annex A, (i)&nbsp;nothing in this Agreement shall limit or in
any way restrict the ability of any Party to seek injunctive or other equitable relief in a court or other judicial body, and (ii)&nbsp;this Annex A shall not apply to, and the Parties shall have no obligation to submit to arbitration, any deadlock
of the Members on any matter requiring unanimous consent of the Members under the Operating Agreement, including pursuant to Section&nbsp;7.02(b) of the Operating Agreement, or any Board deadlock on any matter requiring approval by majority vote of
the entire Board, including pursuant to Section&nbsp;6.02(b)(ii) of the Operating Agreement. </FONT></P>
